claim: Eugénie-les-Bains is ~15 km from Aire-sur-l'Adour, ~15 km from Grenade-sur-l'Adour, ~26 km from Mont-de-Marsan, and ~58 km from Pau; the A65 autoroute passes through Aire-sur-l'Adour with exits at both ends of town.
quote: Aire-sur-l'Adour approximately 15 km away... Grenade sur l'Adour about 15 km... Mont-de-Marsan 26 km from Eugénie-les-Bains... Pau Situated 58 km from Eugénie-les-Bains... A65 autoroute provides the fastest access, passing directly through Aire-sur-l'Adour

claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour to Eugénie-les-Bains is 13.5 km and ~17 minutes by road.
quote: Itinéraire AIRE SUR ADOUR EUGENIE LES BAINS 40. Distance 13,5 km dureé 17 minutes.

claim: Eugénie-les-Bains to Grenade-sur-l'Adour is roughly 11 km, ~14 minutes via D11 (Rue Tursan).
quote: distance is 11 km, with an estimated driving time of 14 minutes via the main road D 11 (Rue Tursan)

claim: Eugénie-les-Bains to Geaune is ~8.4 km, ~9 minutes by car.
quote: Eugénie-les-Bains to Geaune: 9 minutes for a distance of 8.4 kilometers

claim: Hagetmau to Eugénie-les-Bains is ~25.5 km, ~34 minutes by car — at the inner edge of a 30 km radius.
quote: Hagetmau to Eugénie-les-Bains: 34 minutes for a distance of 25.5 kilometers

claim: Samadet sits between Eugénie and Hagetmau (Hagetmau–Samadet is ~10 km, ~11 min), so Samadet from Eugénie is comfortably within the 30 km radius via D-roads.
quote: Hagetmau to Samadet: 10 km with an estimated driving time of 11 minutes

claim: Eugénie-les-Bains to Labastide-d'Armagnac is ~43 km driving (~47 min via D11) — beyond a strict 30 km radius but still a viable half-day loop.
quote: driving distance is 43 km, with an estimated driving time of 47 minutes via the D11 road

claim: Pau to Eugénie-les-Bains is ~68.9 km and ~55 minutes — outside the 30 km radius but reachable for a full day trip via A65.
quote: Itinéraire PAU 64 EUGENIE LES BAINS 40. Distance 68,9 km dureé 55 minutes.

claim: The Musée départemental de la Faïence at Samadet is closed Mondays year-round and only opens afternoons (14h–18h) outside the summer high season (1 July–30 Sept), which dictates afternoon-only itineraries off-peak.
quote: Du 15 février au 30 juin et du 1er octobre au 15 novembre de 14 h à 18 h, et du 1er juillet au 30 septembre de 10 h à 12 h et 14 h à 18 h 30... fermé le lundi, les 1er mai et 1er novembre, et le 11 novembre

claim: The Chapelle Notre-Dame des Cyclistes at Labastide-d'Armagnac is seasonally open 1 May–15 Oct, Tuesday–Sunday 15h–18h (closed Mondays), making it a spring/summer-only stop.
quote: open from May 1st to October 15th, Tuesday to Sunday from 3 PM to 6 PM

claim: The Écomusée de l'Armagnac at Château Garreau (3 km outside Labastide-d'Armagnac) combines a winegrower's museum, still museum, botanical trail and pond walks — a family-friendly half-day with an on-site escape game by reservation.
quote: Château Garreau extends over 82 hectares and houses the Écomusée de l'Armagnac... Winegrower's Museum (17th century), the Stills Museum (collection of more than 10 stills)... escape game is also available (by reservation), along with nature trails around the 6 ponds

claim: Hagetmau's Crypte de Saint-Girons (12th-c. capitals, Monument Historique) is open mid-June to mid-September, 14h30–18h30, closed Sundays — outside that window only by Tourism Office appointment.
quote: open from mid-June to mid-September from 2:30 PM to 6:30 PM except on Sundays. From May to October, contact the Tourism Office

claim: The UNESCO-listed Église Sainte-Quitterie in Aire-sur-l'Adour offers guided summer visits (1 July–14 Sept) at fixed daily slots; off-season visits are by appointment only.
quote: From July 1 to September 14: Visits are available Monday at 4pm and 5pm, Tuesday through Friday at 10am, 11am, 4pm and 5pm... For the rest of the year, visits are by appointment

claim: Saint-Sever's abbey church (a UNESCO Camino site) is open daily 8h–19h, but the Musée des Jacobins only opens July–August afternoons, narrowing the museum window.
quote: L'église abbatiale est ouverte toute l'année, de 8h à 19h. Le Musée des Jacobins est ouvert du 1er juillet au 31 août, de 14h30 à 17h

claim: Pimbo, the oldest bastide of the Landes (founded 1268), is a free open-village stop on the Camino with a Romanesque collégiale — no ticketed hours, suitable any day including Sunday/Monday.
quote: Pimbo est la plus ancienne bastide des Landes fondée en 1268... important stopover sur la route de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle... la collégiale Saint-Barthélemy, une église romane

claim: The Cave des Vignerons de Tursan in Geaune (Mon–Sat 9–12 & 14–17h30, closed Sunday) runs guided cellar tours every Tuesday 14h30 from April to October at €5 — a useful sunset-aperitif anchor for a Tursan loop.
quote: open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 12pm and 2pm to 5:30pm. It's closed on Sundays... Cave tours (approximately 1.5 hours) are scheduled every Tuesday from April to October... at 2:30pm. The cost is €5 per person

claim: Market days in the Tursan/Chalosse loop are staggered — Aire-sur-l'Adour Tue & Sat 8h–12h30 (~50 stalls), Hagetmau Wed (covered) plus Sat 'Le marché prend l'air' May–Oct, Geaune Thu — letting you build a half-day around a different market each morning.
quote: Geaune, the market is held on Thursday, while Hagetmau has a covered market on Wednesday and Aire-sur-l'Adour has a market on Saturday... food market in Aire-sur-l'Adour is open on Tuesday and Saturday throughout the year from 8am to 12:30pm, with approximately 50 vendors

claim: The Château de Pau (Henri IV's birthplace) is open daily 9h30–11h45 & 14h–17h with no Monday closure, but closes 25 Dec, 1 Jan, and 1 May — usable as a full-day Sunday/Monday trip when Landes museums are shut.
quote: Le château est ouvert tous les jours de 9h30 à 11h45 et 14h à 17h... fermé les 25 décembre, 1er janvier et 1er mai. Il n'y a pas de fermeture systématique le lundi

claim: Family-friendly farm visits near Aire include a mini-farm of ~70 animals (rare ducks, Vietnamese pigs) run by an animateur trained for kids, plus 'La Forge animée' at Castelnau-Tursan — both viable substitutes for a proper zoo (the nearest, Zoo de Labenne, is on the Atlantic coast, well outside 30 km).
quote: Aire-sur-l'Adour, there is a mini-farm featuring 70 exceptional animals including birds, rare ducks, and Vietnamese pigs... 900 m² animal park... La Forge animée at Castelnau-Tursan
